undeclared_policy.quote: It is very common for students to be unsure of a major at the beginning of their educational journey or change it along the way. Exploratory students work with both their Academic Advisor and Career Design Center as they decide on a major. University Exploratory Studies Program (UESP) is the academic home for students who have chosen to explore their options prior to deciding on a major.
